title: GNC
description: It combines performance improvements, quality-of-life tweaks, and carefully chosen gameplay mods to create a smooth, fun, and cooperative multiplayer experience.
body:
# GNC Modpack

Welcome to the official **GNC Modpack** – a custom-built collection of mods designed specifically for the GNC community.  
This pack brings together performance tweaks, quality-of-life improvements, and exciting gameplay additions to create the perfect experience for our group servers.

Whether you’re building massive projects, exploring dangerous new dimensions, or just surviving with friends, this modpack has everything you need to make Minecraft more immersive, fun, and cooperative.

- ✅ **Optimized for Multiplayer** – Balanced for smooth performance on our community servers.  
- ✅ **Community-Focused Gameplay** – Features chosen to support collaboration, exploration, and long-term progression.  
- ✅ **Quality of Life & Enhancements** – No unnecessary bloat; only mods that improve gameplay without losing the classic Minecraft feel.  

This pack is made by **GNC, for GNC** – tailored to how *we* play Minecraft together.  
Grab your gear, join your friends, and dive into a modded adventure built around teamwork and creativity!
